facts.business: The Supreme Industries Limited manufactures plastic piping systems, packaging products, industrial components, and consumer products across 25 manufacturing units in India.

capacity_or_capex.item: Acquisition of Wavin business undertakings (3 manufacturing units at Neemrana, Thimapur, Banmore)

guidance_or_targets.statement: Capex plan over the medium term shall be largely funded through internal accruals
Company maintains a dividend pay-out ratio in the range of 35% to 55% of net profit (PAT)
Board proposed final dividend of Rs 25 per share for year ended 31st March 2026

key_risks: Business combination accounting for Wavin acquisition involves significant assumptions and estimates in fair valuation of assets and liabilities
Goodwill recognition of Rs 3.94 crores from Wavin acquisition
